title: Other locked exits consistently spell out their unlock condition inline, e.g. 'go north (locked: defeat it, slip past it (grace), or go around)', but The Hollow Throne simply drops two of its four advertised endings from the menu with no '(locked: ...)' note explaining why, breaking the game's own convention.

Other locked exits consistently spell out their unlock condition inline, e.g. 'go north (locked: defeat it, slip past it (grace), or go around)', but The Hollow Throne simply drops two of its four advertised endings from the menu with no '(locked: ...)' note explaining why, breaking the game's own convention.
